P=PACKET["profile"];source=base64.b64decode(PACKET["source_base64"]);assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()==P["source_sha256"]
assert platform.machine()=="x86_64"
for f,h in P["host_binaries"].items():assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h
root=pathlib.Path(P["root"]);assert not root.exists()
unit=P["unit"];r=subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/systemctl","list-units","--all","--no-legend","--plain",unit+".service"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10);assert not r.stdout.strip() and r.returncode==0
root.mkdir(mode=0o700);os.chown(root,65534,65534)
script=root/"login.py";script.write_bytes(source);script.chmod(0o600);os.chown(script,65534,65534)
argv=["/usr/bin/systemd-run","--unit="+unit]
argv+=["--property="+k+"="+v for k,v in P["properties"].items()]
argv+=["/usr/bin/env","-i","PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1","PATH=/usr/bin:/bin","/usr/bin/python3","-B",str(script)]
r=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
deadline=time.monotonic()+20
while not (root/"ready").exists():
 assert time.monotonic()<deadline;time.sleep(.1)
ready=json.loads((root/"ready").read_text());cg=pathlib.Path("/sys/fs/cgroup"+ready["cgroup"])
lib=ctypes.CDLL("/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6",use_errno=True);fd=os.open(cg,os.O_RDONLY);queries=[]
try:
 for kind in [0,1]:
  ids=(ctypes.c_uint32*16)();attr=ctypes.create_string_buffer(40)
  struct.pack_into("IIIIQI",attr,0,fd,kind,0,0,ctypes.addressof(ids),16)
  code=lib.syscall(321,16,ctypes.byref(attr),40);count=struct.unpack_from("I",attr,24)[0]
  queries.append({"attach_type":kind,"return_code":code,"errno":ctypes.get_errno() if code else 0,"program_count":count})
  assert code==0 and count>0,queries
finally:os.close(fd)
(root/"allow-login").write_text("authorized new private Docker device flow")
print(json.dumps({"scope":"authentication initiation only","source_sha256":P["source_sha256"],"root":P["root"],"unit":unit,"ready":ready,"kernel_bpf_queries":queries,"login_initiated":True,"execution_allowed":False,"native_start_allowed":False},sort_keys=True))
